macros.name: academicyear
macros.doc: Use this macro to specify the academic year in full, i.e. in the form XXXX-YYYY.

macros.name: bamadegree
macros.doc: This allows to specify the official degree through an abbreviation.

macros.name: bamadoctype
macros.doc: This allows to set the nature of the thesis.

macros.name: copyrightnotices
macros.doc: Use this macro to specify additional copyright notice messages to appear in the copyright notice on the bottom of page 2 of your course text.

macros.name: course
macros.doc: Code (first argument) and name (second argument) of the curriculum course this coursematerial or exam belongs to.

macros.name: courseversion
macros.doc: This macro indicates which version of the course this is.

macros.name: degree
macros.doc: This is the official degree name (in the appropriate language, possibly mixed “dutch (english)”).

macros.name: department
macros.doc: The department sets the department’s name tag \@department that is used in the title page information.

macros.name: lecturer
macros.doc: You can add one or more lecturers to the course notes (in Dutch: titularis).

macros.name: publishercode
macros.doc: This macro sets the publisher code of the document.

macros.name: subtitle
macros.doc: This macro sets the \@subtitle tag that later will be used on the title page, in the header/footer and to set the appropriate hyperref tag (if it is loaded).

macros.name: subtitle
macros.doc: This macro sets the \@subtitle tag that later will be used on the title page, in the header/footer and to set the appropriate hyperref tag (if it is loaded).

macros.name: titlepageimage
macros.doc: This sets the filename of the central image on the title page to appear clipped within the curves.

macros.name: versionyear
macros.doc: This is to be the year in which you published the current version of the course in the form YYYY.
